title: Zcash Daily Digest - Thursday, August 27, 2026
content:
Based on the search results, here is the HTML digest:

📅 Thursday, August 27, 2026

🔥 TOP THREADS

  • ZCAP NU7 Poll Opens August 27th: The Zcash Foundation opened its ZCAP (Zcash Community Advisory Panel) poll on NU7 today, Thursday August 27th, with the poll closing Monday, September 14th at 19:00 UTC. This poll follows the NU7 Sentiment Polling from earlier this year and is intended to resolve the outstanding scope questions for NU7.
  • NU7 Coinholder Vote: Valar Group and Project Tachyon called for a coinholder vote beginning August 25, 2026, lasting approximately 18 days. The vote covers NU7 scope decisions including smoother coin issuance, block time reduction, and transaction format updates , requiring at least 1,000,000 ZEC participation to be valid, using a new privacy-focused system allowing shielded wallet users to vote securely.
  • ZF Engineering Update — 10th to 23rd August 2026: With NU6.3 "Ironwood" now live on Mainnet, the ZF team published Zebra 6.3.0 (a recommended security release) and merged a notable new capability: Zebra can now serve light wallets directly, without a separate lightwalletd server in between. They also published a migration guide for zcashd operators moving to Zebra and began early work on faster node-to-node connectivity.
  • 30-Day Review Period: Coinholder-Directed Retroactive Grants Program Q3: The Q3 submission deadline has passed and the mandatory 30-day review period is now underway, covering 37 grant proposals. Those 37 proposals request a combined $9,014,383.20 in funding.
  • Seer Prediction Markets Forecasting Q3 Grant Approvals: A community member launched a prediction market forecasting which projects will be approved in the Q3 ZEC retroactive grant round, running through the review period (August 17–September 16) and closing before the September 17 coinholder poll.

💬 COMMUNITY PULSE

  • The forum is in a high-stakes governance moment: debate is active around whether the NU7 coinholder vote constitutes a binding vote or merely a poll, as no ZIP formally approves making Zcash protocol decisions by vote or specifies how to do so. Simultaneously, the Q3 Coinholder-Directed Retroactive Grants review period runs through September 16, with a polling/voting period to follow starting September 17 — keeping community attention split between protocol governance and ecosystem funding.

🔍 WORTH WATCHING

  • ZCAP NU7 Poll (Opens Today) — Key questions on the table include whether to reduce block time from 75 seconds to 25 (ZIP-218), when to deprecate old Sprout transactions, NSM reissuance timing, and whether to ship NU7 on schedule or delay until all features are complete. The dual ZCAP + coinholder vote dynamic means today's opening is a pivotal moment for Zcash's protocol roadmap.

title: Zcash Daily Digest - Friday, August 28, 2026
content:
📅 Friday, August 28, 2026

🔥 TOP THREADS

  • ZCAP Poll Now Open: NU7 (August 2026): The Zcash Foundation opened its ZCAP (Zcash Community Advisory Panel) SIV poll on NU7 yesterday (Aug 27), running concurrently with the coinholder vote until September 14th at 19:00 UTC. The poll aims to resolve outstanding scope questions for NU7, including topics like the halving mechanism, block time reduction, and Sprout deprecation.
  • NU7 Coinholder Vote: Valar Group and Project Tachyon's coinholder vote on NU7 scope is now live (started Aug 25), requiring a minimum of 1,000,000 ZEC in the Ironwood pool to validate results. Debate continues on the forum over whether this constitutes a binding vote or merely a sentiment poll, with some members noting no ZIP formally authorizes coinholder governance decisions.
  • Zcash East Africa (August–October 2026): A fresh activity report was posted within the last 24 hours detailing the past month's growth for the Zcash East Africa initiative, with a continued focus on expanding Zcash awareness and financial education across the region.
  • The Zcash Daily: The community's daily digest thread (updated yesterday, Aug 27) is actively tracking both the ZCAP NU7 poll opening and the live coinholder vote, serving as a real-time hub for ecosystem news.

💬 COMMUNITY PULSE

  • The forum is almost entirely focused on the dual NU7 governance process — the simultaneous ZCAP advisory poll and the Valar/Tachyon coinholder vote — with healthy tension between those who view coinholders as legitimate decision-makers and those who argue the process lacks formal ZIP-backed authority. Energy is high, participatory, and at times contentious.

🔍 WORTH WATCHING

  • NU7 Coinholder Vote — governance legitimacy debate — Critics on page 2 of the thread argue the vote is technically a "poll, not a vote" since no ZIP formally grants coinholders binding protocol governance power; how this tension resolves could set a major precedent for Zcash's decision-making model going forward, with results expected around September 12–14.
